cheatsheet.title: Describe a Course with Healthcare LOM

intro.description: This cheat sheet walks you through describing a continuing education course with a Healthcare LOM record: a project to keep it in, the record itself, coded keywords, and a check against the standard before you share it.

item.title: Create a project
item.description: A project is a folder of documents that Hermes 2 validates in the background. Create one for your courses (or skip this step if you already have one).

item.title: Create the record
item.description: Create a document from the CME course template: it already has the required metadata schemas, a healthcare section and a credit to fill in. Choose your project as the location.

item.title: Describe the course
item.description: On the General page, enter the title, the description and the language. On Healthcare Education, fill in the credits (type, number, accrediting body) and the target audience. The Overview page shows how complete the record is and what to do next.

item.title: Add MeSH keywords
item.description: Coded keywords make the course easy to find. Add Medical Subject Headings from the offline MeSH index; each keyword records its descriptor ID.

item.title: Check the record
item.description: Open the Problems view: it lists what the schemas and the rules of the standard find. Select a problem and press Ctrl+1 for its quick fixes.

item.title: Save and share
item.description: Save the record (Ctrl+S). To share it, export a printable catalog card with File > Export > HTML Reports.
item.onCompletion: Your course is described. Repeat for the other courses of your program, or import many at once with File > Import from CSV.
